source._comment: LIVE. ND SoS 'Absentee/Vote-by-Mail Ballot & Early Voting Numbers' (vip.sos.nd.gov/abev.aspx?eid=348). ND has no party registration -> turnout-only. The page shows statewide totals; a county dropdown (ASP.NET postback) reveals each county's 'N Ballots Sent, M Ballots Returned' (absentee + VBM combined). We GET the page for the ViewState + county options, then POST once per county (reusing the initial ViewState). cast = returned; mail chase from sent vs returned. eid changes per election. Self-throttled (~3h) since it is ~54 requests and the numbers move slowly.
